content.comment_body: In the [product_name] editor, how can one insert or remove lines within the middle of a ladder diagram?

Hello [user_name], I'm not entirely sure what you're referring to, possibly due to the translation via Google. The connections in the [product_name] tool—digital, analog, or parameter—are added through drag & drop. If you right-click a connection line, a menu appears allowing you to remove it. This should also be covered in the manual. Best regards, [user_name]

Editing ladder diagrams with [product_name] is not very straightforward. There isn't a direct option for adding or deleting rungs in the middle. If you require a new rung somewhere in the middle, you'll need to manually move the lower rungs.
To add a new line, select the one above where you want to make the change and add a new line.
Just to clarify, this discussion is about the [product_name] engineering software, not [product_name] Portal.

Hi, The recommended way to update an existing [product_name] ladder program is: 1. SWITCH TO FBD EDITOR In the FBD editor, you can replace function blocks, add new ones, and rewire signals as needed. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants report that editing ladder diagrams within [product_name] software is cumbersome, especially for adding or removing lines in the middle of diagrams. Workarounds involve manually rearranging elements or using alternative editors available within the software. Users also express confusion about editing methods and note that essential ladder editing functions are either missing or difficult to use.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy-to-use feature allowing direct insertion or deletion of ladder lines (rungs) in the editor, without requiring manual adjustments.
